ValidationRule.description: An account without Segment or Sales Region can not be assigned. - (https://app.asana.com/0/1203326674360215/1204292629506844/f)
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId), IF($Permission.Admin_Automation_Exclusion, false, IF(ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , "Sales Admin"), false, true)), OR( AND( ISBLANK(Hierarchy_Segment__c), ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees), ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep') ), AND( Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'SMB', NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep')), NOT(Account_Owner_Role__c = 'External Sales Rep') ), AND( NOT(Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'SMB'), (ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep')), Account_Owner_Role__c = 'External Sales Rep' ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Hierarchy_Segment__c)), Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'SMB', (ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep')), Account_Owner_Role__c = 'Account Executive' ), AND( NOT(Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'SMB'), NOT(ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep')), NOT(Account_Owner_Role__c = 'Account Executive') ), AND( OR( Hierarchy_Segment__c = 'Unknown', ISBLANK(NumberOfEmployees) ), ISPICKVAL($User.Business_Function__c , 'Sales Development Rep') ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Accounts lacking Segment/Sales Region can't be assigned, and accounts can only be assigned to reps in the same segment. Confirm Employee Count/Billing Address, assign to correct segment rep, or submit RevOps ticket at go/revopsform.
